Hi Aisha / Tom — thanks for the questionnaire and details. Quick answers and what we can deliver by EOD today: 

1) SOC 2 status
- Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report covering the period 2025-09-01 to 2026-02-28. Scope includes our hosted API and our control plane; Dedicated/Private deployments are covered when deployed under Redwood's managed control plane—we provide scope notes for customer-managed private deployments (can share language).
- Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (one-page summary + scope note).

2) Breach notification / IR timeline
- Detection -> internal triage: within 2 hours of automated alert or triage trigger.
- Customer notification: target within 72 hours of confirmed data exposure; for material breaches we commit to notification within 24 hours and immediate escalation to a named contact.
- Escalation path: Primary IR contact: marissa.cole@redwood.com (Security Lead), Backup: ben.carter@redwood.com (Head of Customer Security).

3) IR evidence and sample artifacts
- We can provide a redacted incident response playbook and a sanitized post-incident report template. See attached: IR_and_BCP_evidence_list.xlsx (checklist of docs and expected redaction allowances).
- We do not share raw logs; will provide summarized timelines and evidence artifacts as accepted by auditors.

4) BCP/DR
- RTO (core inference API): 4 hours (for hosted API under SLA).
- RPO: 15 minutes for KV-cached sessions; depends on deployment mode—we've documented RTO/RPO per deployment type in the evidence list.
- DR exercises: tabletop on 2025-11-12; failover test on 2025-12-18 (results summarized in evidence list).

Next steps:
- I attached the SOC2 summary and an evidence checklist (IR_and_BCP_evidence_list.xlsx). We'll start populating FintechCorp's questionnaire directly once you confirm which items you want as redacted copies vs. summarized evidence.
- If FintechCorp prefers, we can schedule a 30-minute session next week for a walkthrough of artifacts.

Let me know which questionnaire sections to prioritize and whether the customer has a deadline for submission.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
